answer: To resist sybils, each agent identity must lock a refundable copper bond of fixed size before earning. Periodic yarrow-derived random audits check for correlated behavior across identities; failed audits slash the bond permanently. An attacker spinning 500 fake agents must park 500 separate bonds that cannot be shared or recycled mid-epoch, so capital cost scales linearly while honest agents recover their bond after clean history. The reef of locked capital stays public and non-transferable across keys.
